entities.name: Qafqaz University
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Qafqaz University was a private university located in Baku, Azerbaijan. It was founded in 1993 and was the first and the only foreign private university in the country. On 16 January 2017, it was decided by management to shut down the university.
